Binary (outcome = "binary"): \(\eta = \mathrm{expit}(\mu - 1.5)\), \(\pi(0,x) = \mathrm{expit}(g)\min(1, e^{-b})\) \(\pi(1,x) = \pi(0,x)e^{b}\) \(b\) = tilt. Truth: eta, eta_obs, obs_rate. Continuous (outcome = "continuous"): \(Y = \mu + \varepsilon\), \(\varepsilon \sim N(0,1)\), \(\pi(y,x) = c(x)\exp\{b\, \Phi(\varepsilon)\}\) \(c(x) = \mathrm{expit}(g)\min(1, e^{-b})\). Since \(\Phi(\varepsilon)\) uniform, ratio propensities \(e^{|b|}\), \(r(x) = c(x)(e^{b} - 1)/b\), quantile function \(Y\) given \(R = 1, X = x\) \(\mu(x) + \Phi^{-1}[\log\{1 + p(e^{b} - 1)\}/b]\), closed form.
